subject: Request: Pilot sponsorship + term variance for QuantMind evaluation
messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir@quantmind.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 10:23:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot ask: additional runway + sponsored credits?

Marissa —

Quick background: we spun up an initial integration over the last two weeks and the results are promising, but our ML team needs another full cycle of experiments (longer context, more embeddings, and a production-like traffic profile) to validate latency and cost. The standard PLG sandbox is fine for an initial POC, but it runs out before we can complete the evaluation.

Two asks:
- 60 additional evaluation days (beyond the standard 30)
- $30k in sponsored credits to cover GPU-heavy runs and embedding index builds

We’re a small Series B (closing in Q4) and we can’t commit to a full committed capacity yet. If Redwood can support the extension + credits, we’ll prioritize integration work and aim to convert to Dedicated within 3 months of a successful POC.

Attaching a short scoping doc and a draft SLA so your team can see the evaluation goals. Happy to jump on a quick 20-min call if helpful.

Thanks —
Samir Shah
Head of ML, QuantMind
samir@quantmind.ai

Attachment: POC_Scoping_Doc.pdf
Attachment: QuantMind_SLA_draft.docx

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Samir Shah <samir@quantmind.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot ask: additional runway + sponsored credits?

Samir —

Thanks for the context and the clear scope. Appreciate you sending the SLA draft. I pulled the team into this thread to run a quick internal approval flow. Two quick notes up front:

1) Our standard PLG sandbox terms cap free credits and extensions; exceptions require Deal Desk and exec sign-off.
2) If we can agree on a mutual action plan (deliverables and success criteria), I can request a one-time sponsorship for the extra runway and credits.

Proposed next steps:
- QuantMind: confirm top 3 evaluation success metrics and target date for conversion decision (can you confirm by EOD Mon?).
- Redwood: I’ll request approval for a 60-day extension + up to $30k in credits; I’ll include the scoping doc and the SLA for legal review.

I’ll follow up here once I have an internal decision — cc’ing Deal Desk (Aditya) and Finance (David) for the authorization path.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0127

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai, chloe_martin@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 15 Nov 2025 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Requesting Exec/Finance sign-off: QuantMind pilot sponsorship (QNT-4521)

Team —

Summary: QuantMind (Series B) is asking for a 60-day extension to their sandbox and $30k in sponsored credits to complete a more production-like ML evaluation. They’ve attached a scoping doc and a draft SLA; they expect to prioritize integration and aim to convert to Dedicated within ~90 days if results are positive.

Why this is strategic:
- High-quality ML customer in healthcare analytics (strong reference potential).
- Workload exercises heavy embedding indexing and long-context generation — this maps to areas where our runtime differentiates (KV caching, batching).
- Conversion probability (rep estimate): 55% within 90 days if we can fund the final validation run.

Request:
- Approve 60 additional days on PLG sandbox (one-off)
- Approve up to $30,000 in sponsored credits
- Accept a billing hold (we’d allow the sandbox to stay in trial; Finance requests either a PO or a pre-authorized billing commitment before conversion)

Risks/controls proposed:
- Condition sponsorship on a signed one-page addendum that: (a) defines success metrics, (b) sets a firm conversion decision date, and (c) requires a notice to Redwood if they spin up paid production endpoints before conversion.
- Limit credits release in two tranches (15k on extension start, 15k after milestone review).

Attachments: POC_Scoping_Doc.pdf, QuantMind_SLA_draft.docx

Please reply with approvals, objections, or edits. I’m happy to jump on a 15-min call to walk through.

Thanks —
Marissa

From: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 16 Nov 2025 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Requesting Exec/Finance sign-off: QuantMind pilot sponsorship (QNT-4521)

Marissa / Team —

I reviewed the draft SLA and the scoping doc. Legal is comfortable with a one-page addendum that captures:
- Term length (60 days extension)
- Credit tranche mechanics (15k upfront, 15k contingent on milestone)
- Success metrics (we should reference the exact KPIs QuantMind confirms)
- IP & data treatment: sandbox remains ephemeral; no model ownership claims.
- Liability cap: keep to existing platform T&Cs (no expanded liabilities for this one-off).

Two asks from Legal/Privacy:
1) Add a short clause requiring a simple signed attestation that QuantMind will not upload regulated customer PHI into the trial environment (we can accept hashed or synthetic data only).
2) If they want extended log retention beyond default sandbox windows, we need a security review and a Slack ticket to infra — prefer to avoid expanded retention unless strictly necessary.

If Finance approves the PO/billing terms, Legal can prepare the addendum and route for signature.

-Chloe
Chloe Martin, Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.ai

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai, chloe_martin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 16:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Requesting Exec/Finance sign-off: QuantMind pilot sponsorship (QNT-4521)

Approved with conditions —

1) Approve the 60-day extension and up to $30k in sponsorship, to be released as Marissa proposed (15k / 15k contingent on milestone).
2) Finance (David): require a PO or signed commitment that triggers the first tranche; if PO timing is slow, authorize a one-week billing hold to allow the extension to start, but no more than one week without a PO.
3) Legal (Chloe): prepare the one-page addendum incorporating your two asks (PHI attestation + default retention restriction).
4) Marissa / Aditya: draft the milestone definition and the conversion decision date; I want a clear go/no-go metric at the 45-day checkpoint.

I’m comfortable taking this as a one-off given the 55% conversion probability and the strategic reference potential. Keep me posted if anything material changes.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber, Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
